phases.label: Packet I/O
phases.description: Packet entry from or queueing toward a network device.

phases.label: IPv4 and routing
phases.description: IPv4 validation, hooks, route selection, and local delivery.

phases.label: Socket and TCP
phases.description: Socket dispatch, TCP lookup, state processing, and transmission.

phases.label: Observation boundary
phases.description: The stable userspace API boundary for selected TCP state.

symbols.name: netif_receive_skb
symbols.description: Enter the receive core with one sk_buff.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff handed to receive core

symbols.name: __netif_receive_skb_one_core
symbols.description: Run the protocol receive path for one packet.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff consumed or passed to protocol handler

symbols.name: ip_rcv
symbols.description: Validate an IPv4 packet before the pre-routing hook.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff retained on accepted path

symbols.name: NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING
symbols.description: Run IPv4 Netfilter pre-routing before the ip_rcv_finish continuation.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff retained, consumed, or stolen by a hook

symbols.name: ip_rcv_finish
symbols.description: Continue after pre-routing, route the skb, and dispatch dst_input.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff passed toward route input

symbols.name: ip_route_input_noref
symbols.description: Reuse or compute a route for an incoming packet.
symbols.ownership: route attached to sk_buff without a caller reference

symbols.name: ip_route_input_slow
symbols.description: Perform the uncached IPv4 input route lookup.
symbols.ownership: computed route attached to sk_buff

symbols.name: dst_input
symbols.description: Invoke the route destination input callback, usually ip_local_deliver for local IPv4.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff passed to destination input callback

symbols.name: ip_local_deliver
symbols.description: Reassemble if needed and enter local delivery hooks.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff retained through reassembly or passed to hook

symbols.name: NF_INET_LOCAL_IN
symbols.description: Run IPv4 Netfilter local-input before the ip_local_deliver_finish continuation.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff retained, consumed, or stolen by a hook

symbols.name: ip_local_deliver_finish
symbols.description: Dispatch a locally delivered datagram to its IP protocol handler.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff passed to registered transport handler

symbols.name: tcp_v4_rcv
symbols.description: Receive and validate an IPv4 TCP segment.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff queued to a socket or freed

symbols.name: __inet_lookup_skb
symbols.description: Select an established or listening socket for an sk_buff.
symbols.ownership: socket reference returned for the packet

symbols.name: __inet_lookup_established
symbols.description: Search the established transport socket hash.
symbols.ownership: matched socket held for receive processing

symbols.name: tcp_rcv_established
symbols.description: Process a segment on the TCP established fast or slow path.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff consumed by TCP receive processing

symbols.name: tcp_ack
symbols.description: Apply an acknowledgment to TCP sender state.
symbols.ownership: socket sender state updated; sk_buff remains with caller

symbols.name: sock_sendmsg
symbols.description: Enter protocol sendmsg through the socket layer.
symbols.ownership: userspace bytes borrowed through msghdr

symbols.name: tcp_sendmsg
symbols.description: Acquire the socket lock for a TCP send request.
symbols.ownership: socket locked while userspace bytes are copied

symbols.name: tcp_sendmsg_locked
symbols.description: Queue application bytes into TCP write buffers.
symbols.ownership: application bytes copied into socket-owned sk_buffs

symbols.name: tcp_write_xmit
symbols.description: Choose queued TCP segments eligible for transmission.
symbols.ownership: socket write-queue sk_buffs selected for transmission

symbols.name: tcp_transmit_skb
symbols.description: Wrap __tcp_transmit_skb, which builds TCP headers and calls queue_xmit.
symbols.ownership: transmit clone handed toward network output

symbols.name: icsk_af_ops->queue_xmit
symbols.description: Address-family queue_xmit callback; IPv4 sockets use ip_queue_xmit.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff handed to address-family output

symbols.name: ip_route_output_flow
symbols.description: Resolve an IPv4 output route for a flow.
symbols.ownership: referenced route returned to the socket flow

symbols.name: ip_queue_xmit
symbols.description: IPv4 transport queueing callback.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff handed to IPv4 output

symbols.name: __ip_queue_xmit
symbols.description: Find or reuse a route, build the IPv4 header, and enter local output.
symbols.ownership: route attached and IPv4 header prepended to sk_buff

symbols.name: ip_local_out
symbols.description: Run local IPv4 output hooks before dst_output.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff retained, consumed, or stolen by a hook

symbols.name: ip_output
symbols.description: Run post-routing and choose the output device path.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff passed through post-routing

symbols.name: ip_finish_output
symbols.description: Apply final IPv4 output handling before neighbor output.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff handed toward neighbor output

symbols.name: __dev_queue_xmit
symbols.description: Queue an sk_buff to device traffic control or a driver.
symbols.ownership: sk_buff consumed by queueing or driver path

symbols.name: tcp_get_info
symbols.description: Bridge internal TCP state to the TCP_INFO observation API.
symbols.ownership: selected socket state copied into caller-owned tcp_info

edges.explanation: The receive entry invokes the one-core receive helper.
Protocol registration dispatches an IPv4 sk_buff to ip_rcv.
After IPv4 validation, ip_rcv enters the pre-routing hook point.
An accepted packet resumes at ip_rcv_finish.
The continuation requests an input route when the skb lacks one.
A cache miss or unresolved route enters the full input lookup.
The selected route installs the destination callback later used by dst_input.
A local IPv4 route dispatches its input callback to ip_local_deliver.
Local delivery enters the local-input Netfilter hook point.
An accepted local packet resumes at ip_local_deliver_finish.
The registered TCP protocol handler receives the local IPv4 datagram.
TCP receive looks up the socket associated with the skb tuple.
The generic lookup first searches the established socket hash.
A matched established socket selects established-state receive processing.
Segments carrying acknowledgment state enter tcp_ack when required by established processing.
The socket layer dispatches sendmsg through the TCP protocol operations.
After locking the socket, tcp_sendmsg invokes its locked implementation.
Queued write data is subsequently considered by TCP transmission selection.
Eligible write-queue sk_buffs are passed to the TCP transmit wrapper.
TCP dispatches the built segment through the address-family queue_xmit callback.
IPv4 TCP sockets bind queue_xmit to ip_queue_xmit.
The public IPv4 queue wrapper enters __ip_queue_xmit.
Without a reusable cached route, __ip_queue_xmit resolves the output flow.
After route resolution, output resumes at local IPv4 output.
With a route ready, __ip_queue_xmit enters local IPv4 output directly.
After local-output hooks accept the skb, dst_output dispatches to ip_output.
Post-routing acceptance continues in ip_finish_output.
Neighbor output eventually dispatches the skb into device queueing.
Userspace selects the TCP_INFO socket option through getsockopt.
TCP getsockopt handling dispatches TCP_INFO collection to tcp_get_info.
tcp_get_info copies selected internal transport state into struct tcp_info.
The bounded UAPI structure is copied back using the caller-provided option length.
